plainText:
Slick Slowking (Japanese: VS ヤドキング VS ), titled Stop Snoring, Slowking in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 164th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 74th chapter of the .

==Plot==
 
 and , bewildered that the Masked Man appears to be somewhere else, and not among the Gym Leaders as they were told, then realize that is the one being attacked. Carl and Sham boast that not even legendary Pokémon escape capture by the Masked Man. They switch off the live recording, declaring that the Masked Man's arrival is imminent, and that Team Rocket will be resurrected once more. With that, they throw down their Team Rocket jackets and put on their half-masks.

Gold, still unable to move, suddenly realizes that it is because of . He and Crystal find themselves surrounded by several and . Aibo finds a way to release Polibo from its , and the instantly puts its opposition to sleep. However, Sham's s loudly to create solid air blocks, and Carl's breathes out fire while asleep. Crystal has Bonee swat away Slowking's Snore while Gold has Polibo counter Magcargo's attack. Both soon struggle with their opponents.

Sham wastes no time with their opponents' struggle, and begins hacking the central controls. Gold and Crystal eventually have and Sunbo's combined knock out Magcargo and Slowking by sending them crashing towards their Trainers. By this time, the alert sirens sound. Despite being grabbed by the collar by Gold, Carl gloats at his successful mission before fainting. The monitors state that the Magnet Train lock is being released. 

At the Magnet Train station serving the Indigo Plateau, two guards who are watching the Magnet Train suddenly become horrified when the train's lights flicker on to reveal a large number of masked s inside. The guards quickly rush to alert their boss, but the Team Rocket Elite Trio zap them unconscious and enter the train.

==Major events==
and battle against Sham and Carl in the control room of the Indigo Plateau.
Gold and Crystal defeat Sham and Carl, but get locked in the control room.
